source.sha256_note: Recorded by the treadmill conversion receipt; size and mtime re-checked before and after, bytes not rehashed.

scope: 50 Tread recordings x 2 sides: 5 jointAngles channels, plus hip/knee/ankle jointMoments and jointPowers for the kinetic layout; markers and plates not read.
criterion: Alternate branch: |component 2| > 90 deg. A Cardan triple with the middle angle outside [-90, 90] is the second solution of the same rotation; standard extraction returns the middle angle inside it.
rule_proposed_not_applied: (c1, c2, c3) -> (wrap(c1 + 180), wrap(180 - c2), wrap(c3 + 180)) for frames meeting the criterion; log recording, side, channel and frame runs. Identity holds for every Cardan order and for per-component sign flips.
